in_order: Your Directors present the 40th Annual Report of Acme Industries Limited for the financial year ended March 31, 2025. Revenue from operations grew 20.8% to ₹1,45,000 crore, compared with ₹1,20,000 crore in the previous year.
The increase was primarily attributable to higher domestic sales. Acme Chemicals Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, contributed ₹12,500 crore to consolidated revenue.
The Company had 23,450 employees as on March 31, 2025.
Domestic demand stayed strong through the year, led by public infrastructure spending and steady housing construction.
Input costs eased in the second half of the year, which helped operating margins recover to their earlier levels.
Exports fell 4% because of weaker demand in Europe and longer shipping times through the Red Sea.
The outlook for FY2026 remains positive, subject to normal monsoon conditions and stable commodity prices.
